message: v1.8.11: fix(v1.8.11): match Payments view edge padding, header, and modal form classes
changelog: Extension In-App Update Reliability (src/background/autoUpdate.ts, src/popup/modules/settingsUpdates.ts, updater/blackboarder-updater.ps1): Clicking Update now now triggers an immediate extension reload (chrome.runtime.reload()) once new files land on disk instead of waiting for reloadWhenIdle() while the popup/side panel is still open, surfaces 'error', 'dev-checkout', and 'up-to-date' responses explicitly in toast notifications instead of silently resetting the button, and skips locked or byte-identical self-updater scripts (updater/host.bat) during Windows file copies while cache-busting the GitHub ZIP request and cleaning up stale files even on matching-build runs.
